name: Camping 101: Fishing
summary: Your fishing skill can bring comfort to a camp. Someone near Sen'jin Village can teach you to craft a Fish Bowl for your fellow adventurers.

sections.title: A Camp Comfort
sections.body: You can speak with Lau'Tiki near Sen'jin Village once you have shown proficiency in fishing. Lau'Tiki can teach you to craft a Fish Bowl, a camping fixture meant to bring joy to you and your fellow adventurers. A happier camp, the giver hopes, makes for stronger fighters.

faq.q: What can fishing do for my camp?
faq.answer: Your fishing skill can help you learn to craft a Fish Bowl for camp.

faq.q: Who teaches me to make a Fish Bowl?
faq.answer: Lau'Tiki near Sen'jin Village can teach you to craft a Fish Bowl once you have shown proficiency in fishing.

faq.q: What is the Fish Bowl for?
faq.answer: The Fish Bowl is a camping fixture intended to bring joy to you and your fellow adventurers.

angles.text: As a fisher, you can learn to craft a Fish Bowl for your camp once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
